description: Privileged Role Administrator - can grant any Entra role (including Global Administrator) to any principal.

telemetry.detail: Entra ID audit log: 'Add member to role / Add role assignment (as Privileged Role Administrator)' (directory logging is default-on).
Role-assignment changes to privileged roles are a common alerting rule.

abuse_primitive: Assign GA (or another privileged role) to a controlled principal.
notes: The classic Entra privilege-escalation edge; the role grant is always logged.
